items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: INTERVIEWER: ...Claude Hopkins... Those came after that I just named.

ctx.x: I really don't know if that was the last poll opinions, but anyway, for several years I was in the top ten.

Well look at the bands below you. After you comes Earl Hines, Andy Kirk, Nobel Cecil, Les Hite, Ella Fitzgerald, John Kirby, Cecil Burke, Tiny Bradshaw, Swinging Rays, Claude Hopkins, Fats Waller, Adie South, Al Cooper--that would be the Savoy Sultans-- Coban Hawkins and Lucky Millinder.
Those came after that I just named.
